M1.08 weighting independent review at c58f03c48945967021ad343958b9d7ac647fff83 (base 38f0e5fe) — APPROVE-WITH-FIXES for the code as a target-block utility; criterion 2 should NOT close until the scope ruling below. Source-level only (no build/tests by reviewer). Fresh-context reviewer; scope finding re-checked by me against PRD :473-476 and your [decision] note.
Blobs: RidgeTargetGeometry.scala 3766b166, AlderRidgeRegression.scala d74d8aef, AlderRidgeRegressionSuite.scala f12d46d5.

VERIFIED
- Semantics: target blocks only; w_j = mass_b/size_b normalized; selection loss sum_app sum_j w_j r_j^2 / (n_app * sum w) — numerator and denominator use the same weights (ARR :616-618, RTG :48-59); uniform case reduces to SSE/(n q). Oracle uses the same form.
- Typed refusals: blank name, empty/blank/duplicate targets, non-positive/non-finite mass, gaps, overlaps, foreign keys, mass overflow, per-target underflow, axis mismatch (descriptor carries key-signature digest, so reordering is caught).
- Estimator unchanged: diff touches only geometry plumbing, selection numerator/denominator, fit-context/audit identity; raw-inner selection, preparation scope, plan/budget, precheck, NonFiniteSelectionLoss (now on weighted loss), constant policy intact; fixed-lambda test asserts identical predictions/weights weighted vs uniform.
- Identity carried through model, RidgePrediction, RidgeOofRow, result, refit, selection receipt; plan fingerprint includes geometry.identity (schema v2, component v2).
- Metrics typed (no invented R^2; non-finite -> UndefinedNonFinite); per-output metrics remain unweighted.
- Oracle weighted-oracle.py independent (NumPy normal equations, no shared helpers); tests at 1e-10; weighting changes selected lambda in run 0 (2.0 vs 0.1); fixed-lambda invariance, duplication/mass rescale, permutation, refit, outer perturbation sentinel, variant-specific refusals.

MAJOR (scope)
- Criterion 2 reads "Feature-block weights ..." and PRD :475-476 "metric, including feature-block weighting". Built: TARGET-block utility; predictors/penalty explicitly not weighted (RTG :5-6, :30-34). Your [decision] note re-scopes this, but that is a reinterpretation of an owner-authored criterion. Suggest `fray ask-owner` for an explicit ruling ("feature-block" = target-feature blocks in the continuous-target metric?) recorded on the ticket, or split predictor-block weighting into a follow-up. In context the target-metric reading is plausible, but it should be ruled, not inferred.

MINOR
- RidgeTargetGeometry is a plain class without equals/hashCode but embedded in case classes (RidgeOofRow, RidgePrediction, RidgeSelectionReceipt, result): equality silently becomes reference equality. Override on identity + responseAxis.
- RidgeInnerUnitReceipt.squaredErrorByPenalty (:200) now holds WEIGHTED sums — rename or document.
- RegressionPooledAssessment not self-describing (weighted vs uniform); with geometry the plain cell-mean pooled MSE is no longer reported. Add a loss tag or report both.
- Uniform path computes (sqrt(1/q) r)^2 vs r^2/q: few-ULP drift; confirm base exact-comparison tests still pass.
- Public case-class constructors RidgePrediction/RidgeOofRow use require (throw on public surface) — consider private[predictive].
NIT
- Fingerprint hashes origin.toString (RTG :94): free-text reason changes plan identity; write an explicit tag + reason.
- Evidence: weighted-oracle-receipt.json source_sha = 38f0e5fe (base), not c58f03c4; source-01.json "status": "". Gates for c58f03c4 still owed.
Compile/portability by reading: low risk; Failure.cause and model.weights existence assumed (outside diff).
